name: clawyer-superengine
description: Runs a self-represented legal matter like a small law firm, in your own folder: guided setup that asks five plain questions and installs what your computer is missing, matter and evidence intake, a check of every cited court case against a free public database, a 15-reviewer council for court orders, filings and anything you are asked to sign, a verification gate, and a premortem before anything goes out. Works for family, tax, and business or money disputes in any US state; its built-in doctrine was written for Mississippi family court and is labelled as an example for any other state or kind of case. Built on pro-se-firm v1.7.0 by Mic H. (MIT). Not a lawyer and not legal advice. Needs Claude Code Desktop. 9 skills, 19 agents.
